preregistration_boundary: This specification was frozen before executing the submission analysis described here, but after the model-training and validation results existed. It is a retrospective locked analysis plan, not a prospective or public preregistration.

design.algorithmic_repeat: training seed nested within fold for resampling
design.track_role: descriptive repeated endpoint; tracks are not treated as independent inferential replicates
design.point_estimate: unweighted mean of the five fold-specific means, each fold mean averaging its three seeds
design.missing_data: retain all run and track rows; summaries use finite values and report the contributing count
design.hypothesis_tests: none; effect estimates and confidence intervals are reported without p values
design.multiplicity: three primary contrasts are identified in advance for emphasis; remaining matched contrasts and diagnostic endpoints are labelled secondary

run_level_endpoints.definition: 0.5 * gene-exon coverage Pearson on log1p values + 0.5 * 128-bp per-track Pearson on log1p values

bootstrap.resampling: sample five folds with replacement; for every sampled fold occurrence sample its three paired seeds with replacement; average seeds within occurrence and then average the five sampled fold means
bootstrap.paired_contrast_resampling: form candidate-minus-comparator differences at identical fold and seed before applying the common hierarchical resampling scheme

track_analysis.long_form_scope: every 241-entry per-track dictionary in each of the 90 validation JSON files, plus the exact derived per-track primary score
track_analysis.configuration_summary: for each configuration and track, average the 15 fold-by-seed values; report standard deviation, range and finite count descriptively
track_analysis.panel_d_category_selection: For study, stage, tissue and treatment, show the two largest categories with at least five tracks, breaking ties lexicographically; show all three signal-strength tertiles. Selection depends only on manifest prevalence, never on model performance.

strata.study: exact sra_study_accession; missing values retained as Missing/unknown
strata.stage: development_stage collapsed only into explicit embryo, L1-L4, young-adult, dauer and larval-time-course classes; all other values retained verbatim
strata.tissue: case-insensitive whole-organism and embryo synonyms collapsed; all other tissue_or_cell_type values retained verbatim
strata.treatment: Reported treatment/selection if a non-administrative condition is present or genotype/strain explicitly contains treated or RNAi; Missing/unknown only when condition, genotype and strain are all missing; otherwise No reported treatment
strata.signal_strength: tertiles of development_train_nonzero_mean across all 241 tracks using linear quantiles; boundaries and counts are emitted in analysis_manifest.json

track_analysis.stratum_inference: descriptive only; no track-level p values or confidence intervals

figure_contract.core_conclusion: Under matched development cross-validation, Model B trained with paper loss has the strongest composite biological score, with paired fold-seed gains over A and C and heterogeneous track-level effects.

panels.a: six configuration estimates with fold-primary 95% confidence intervals and five fold means
panels.b: three primary paired contrasts decomposed into the composite and its two components
panels.c: descriptive distributions of 241 per-track composite scores
panels.d: descriptive B/paper minus A/paper per-track differences across metadata-defined strata
